worker_claim.report: Ticket logs read all reports for the requested ticket, include active executions from runtime state, fail closed on missing or ambiguous ticket state, and terminate follow at accepted or done.
worker_claim.summary: Added `logs ticket <ticket-id>` and `-f` support with durable ticket-state validation, execution history headers, and execution-ID-based follow switching across retries. Existing execution-scoped log behavior remains unchanged.
